newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai tapioca exports down 0.8 pct in yr to Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: Thai tapioca exports down 0.8 pct in yr to Aug 15.

text.p: Thai tapioca exports fell to about 2.36 million tonnes between January 1 and August 15 from 2.38 million tonnes a year ago, the Board of Trade of Thailand said on Tuesday.

The board said 2.36 million tonnes of tapioca pellets and 2,700 tonnes of tapioca chips were exported during the first 8-1/2 months of this year, against 2.21 million tonnes and 169,067 tonnes a year ago.

The Netherlands lifted 1.69 million tonnes during January 1/ August 15 against 1.75 million a year ago, Spain imported 184,441 tonnes (302,505), South Korea 346,575 (19,748), Portugal 96,222 (110,166), Turkey 17,350 (nil), Japan 16,200 (9,500), Ireland 8,763 (nil), and Malaysia 7,300 (nil).
Pellet exports rose to 89,398 tonnes during the first half of August from 98,448 a year ago.
The Netherlands lifted 46,140 tonnes of pellets during the period against 98,448 a year ago, South Korea 24,483 (nil), Portugal 13,965 (nil), and Spain 4,810 (nil).
